MemeDef.label: cosmic balance
MemeDef.description: Life and death, light and shadow, wildness and order are all sacred. To enthrone one principle above the others is the first step toward ruin.

MemeDef.label: death stewardship
MemeDef.description: The dead are not refuse. They are memory, warning, inheritance, and law. Their bodies must be honored and their passage guarded.

MemeDef.label: verdant concord
MemeDef.description: The land is a living covenant. Wood, water, beast, soil, and settlement must flourish together, or all shall wither apart.

MemeDef.label: stoic craft
MemeDef.description: Stone remembers. Iron obeys. Labor is prayer when done with discipline, purpose, and honor.
